name: VramBlock_LoadCached
domain: Allocates or reuses a cached VRAM block, optionally fills or DMA-loads it, and returns its tile index.
expressed: validates the cache slot and maximum block size
reuses a same-sized cached allocation or frees and reallocates a changed entry
records the size and VRAM offset in the slot cache
supports no-load, shared-fill, and DMA-copy source modes
returns the allocated VRAM offset as a 32-byte tile index
